title: Shortest Stretch That Is Enough
statement:
A solar panel produced a positive amount of energy in each of `n` consecutive hours. Find the smallest number of consecutive hours whose total output is at least `S`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `S`. The second line contains `n` positive integers, the output of each hour.

## Output
Print the length of the shortest block of consecutive hours whose total is at least `S`. If no block reaches `S`, print `0`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `1 <= S <= 10^15`
